_label: DEMO DATA: eight made-up roles for the agent eval. Every company and posting is invented; no real employer, person or opening. Labels say whether the role is a good or bad fit for the made-up candidate in facts.json.

cases.label: good
cases.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments Platform
cases.description: Lead the roadmap for a payments platform used by other product teams. You will manage a team of about eight, work with engineering on reliability, and own the metrics review. Six or more years of product management required.
cases.reason: Senior PM scope matching the payments platform and team-lead experience.

cases.label: good
cases.title: Staff Product Manager, Growth and Onboarding
cases.description: Own self-serve onboarding for a made-up learning product. Cut time to first value, run experiments, and partner with design on a mobile rebuild. Senior or staff level, six or more years.
cases.reason: Onboarding, experiments and design partnership all appear in the facts.

cases.label: good
cases.title: Senior Product Manager, Data API
cases.description: Own the roadmap for a developer-facing data API with a few hundred business customers. Talk to customers, set pricing with finance, and decide what ships next.
cases.reason: API roadmap ownership plus pricing work, both in the facts.

cases.label: good
cases.title: Senior Product Manager, Pricing and Packaging
cases.description: Run pricing experiments across several regional markets for an invented subscription product. Report results to leadership each week and write the decision memos.
cases.reason: Pricing experiments across markets and a metrics review habit are in the facts.

cases.label: bad
cases.title: Associate Product Manager
cases.description: Entry level role for someone with zero to two years of experience. You will write tickets and support senior managers. Rotational program.
cases.reason: Junior title and scope, well below senior or staff.

cases.label: bad
cases.title: Principal Firmware Engineer
cases.description: Write embedded C for a sensor board. Five or more years of firmware experience, on-call rotation, onsite five days a week. No product management duties.
cases.reason: An engineering job, not product management, and onsite only.

cases.label: bad
cases.title: Regional Sales Manager
cases.description: Hit quarterly quota for a territory of invented stores. Travel two weeks a month, cold calling, commission only.
cases.reason: A sales quota job with no product work and commission-only pay.

cases.label: bad
cases.title: Senior Product Manager, Robotics Actuators
cases.description: Own the roadmap for robotic actuators. Requires a mechanical engineering degree, five years shipping hardware, and supplier negotiation in two languages. Onsite five days.
cases.reason: Senior PM title but a hardware specialism and onsite requirement the facts do not support.
